variants.specifics: Brackenford: Anselm's novice Pip followed the Urchins into the old barrow and their shaman turned him into an Urchin.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Kind sir! Please, help us!

My novice Pip went into the old barrow across the ford after those Urchins, and he never came back. Last night an Urchin came scratching at the chapel door, crying my name in Pip's voice! Their shaman has turned the poor boy into one of them!

Bring him back to the Chapel of the Ford and I can lift the curse. Will you go?

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: I've got my prayers to say. You fetch the boy.

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: Here's a human face at last and someone besides Urchins who might take me home!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: No matter if the Urchins chase us clear to the ford! The chapel is holy ground. Even Urchins wouldn't dare set foot in the Chapel of the Ford!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text:
Pip! Hold still, boy...

There! He's himself again! Not a whisker of Urchin left on him! Bless you, brave Adventurer!

Please, take this spell book. You have done the chapel a great service.

journal.text: Find Pip among the Urchins in the tunnels beneath the old barrow.

variants.specifics: Krennack: Granny Vell's pet mole Duggles dug his way into the Ogre camp under the Great Lift.

plea.speaker: Vell
plea.text:
Help! Oh, somebody help me! My Duggles dug his way right into the Ogre camp under the Great Lift!

Those brutes will eat anything that wriggles! My sweet little mole will end up in an Ogre's stew pot!

Please, kind stranger, find my Duggles and bring him home to me!

reminder.speaker: Vell
reminder.text: By the way, Duggles always squeaks when he's frightened...

found.speaker: Duggles
found.text: Salutations, kind sir! I am most relieved you have come at long last!

completion.speaker: Vell
completion.text:
Duggles! My precious Duggles! You're home, you're home!

Bless you, kind stranger. Please accept this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Bring Granny Vell's pet mole home from the Ogre camp.

variants.specifics: Skell: Marda's husband Bodkin, out after frogs, has walked into the Ogre camp north of town and been caught again.

plea.speaker: Marda
plea.text:
Oh, that fool! That great soggy fool! The Ogres have caught my Bodkin again! He goes out after frogs and walks straight into their camp every time! He's been caught more often than the frogs!

Their camp is north of town, past the dead trees. Please, bring him home before they put him in the pot! I'll give you anything!

reminder.speaker: Marda
reminder.text: Go, quickly! The Ogres' pot grows hot.

following.speaker: Bodkin
following.text: Take me home, young sir. I'll be right behind you.

completion.speaker: Marda
completion.text:
Bodkin! You're home, and still in one piece! Oh, thank you, thank you, kind sir!

Please, take this Ankh. It's the least I can do.

journal.text:
Get the cage key from the Ogres and set Bodkin free.
The key is probably hanging in the Ogre Chief's tent.

variants.specifics: Varrok: Hesk's partner Wobbin keeps sneaking off to sell pots to the Ogres at the Stone Bridge, and they have locked him in a cage again.

plea.speaker: Hesk
plea.text:
Oh, no! Not again! Those Ogres have caught Wobbin again!?

That fool keeps sneaking off to the Stone Bridge to sell pots to the Ogres! And every time they lock him in a cage and keep the pots!

Please, young sir, get him out of there before they throw him in the stew. I'll make it worth your while.

found.speaker: Wobbin
found.text: Drat it all! Now they've gone and smashed my best kettle! I'll try to keep up behind you. Take me to Hesk!

following.speaker: Wobbin
following.text: Whew... looks like I'm not Ogre stew yet. Keep going, friend.

completion.speaker: Hesk
completion.text:
Wobbin! You big oaf, you're home!

Bless you, kind stranger! Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Go to the Stone Bridge and free Wobbin from the Ogres.

variants.specifics: Kesk: Marla's pet parrot Beaky flew off when the Undead came ashore and is stuck in the Drowned Chapel among the Zombies.

plea.speaker: Marla
plea.text:
Beaky! My poor Beaky!

He flew off when the dead men came ashore last night, and now he's stuck in the old Drowned Chapel at the west end of the lake! I can hear him squawking from here!

Those Zombies will pluck him bald! Please, kind stranger, bring my Beaky home!

reminder.speaker: Marla
reminder.text: Oh, it's you again. Have you found my Beaky?

found.speaker: Beaky
found.text: Awk! Sorry but you need a cracker!

following.speaker: Beaky
following.text: The water down here is even deeper than it looks. Awk! Be very, very careful. Remember, Beaky is a good bird.

completion.speaker: Marla
completion.text:
Beaky! Oh, you're home! Mama's been worried sick!

Thank you, thank you, kind sir! Take these potions, it's all I have. Say thank you, Beaky!

journal.text: Rescue the parrot of Marla the net-maker.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Master Wobbin muddled a Teleport spell and sent his apprentice Nettle into the Bat Caves under Crag Hill.

plea.speaker: Wobbin
plea.text:
Oh, this is a catastrophe! The worst blunder of my whole miserable career!

I was showing young Nettle the Teleport spell and I muddled the words. Instead of across the room, I sent her clear into the Bat Caves under Crag Hill!

If the Arch-Mage finds out, he'll take away my wand! Go north to Crag Hill and bring her back before anybody notices she's gone!

reminder.speaker: Wobbin
reminder.text: I am ashamed to see a stranger clean up the mess which my own clumsy tongue has made.

found.speaker: Nettle
found.text: You have come all the way down here to get me!

completion.speaker: Wobbin
completion.text:
Nettle! You're home! Oh, thank the stars!

And not a word to the Arch-Mage, eh? Please accept this Wizard Robe as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Rescue Nettle from the Bat Caves beneath Crag Hill.

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: Old Mildra's parrot Mungo flew out after a moth and the Ogres in the camp below the south cliff mean to bake him in a pie.

plea.speaker: Mildra
plea.text:
Oh, my Mungo! My poor Mungo! The Ogres have got him!

He flew out the window after a moth and the Ogres from the camp below the south cliff caught him in a sack. I heard them laughing about a pie! A pie!

Please, young sir, bring my bird home safe. I'm just an old woman. I can't go down there.

reminder.speaker: Mildra
reminder.text: Mungo is the dearest friend and sole comfort of my old age. Your trip down that cliff will show whether you have any heart at all.

found.speaker: Mungo
found.text: Awk! This road climbs to Ulmgard, the mighty frozen stronghold of the north!

following.speaker: Mungo
following.text: March up the ice stair. From there we climb past the stables and on to Warden Galmor's hall.

completion.speaker: Mildra
completion.text:
Mungo! My darling Mungo! You're home! Thank goodness!

Here, kind sir, take this spell book as a token of my appreciation. It's no use to an old woman like me.

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: Yarra's husband Quell walked into the Burning Caves to prove his new apron could stand any fire and has not come out.

plea.speaker: Yarra
plea.text:
Please, you must help me! My Quell got himself a new leather apron and swore it could stand any fire! He walked into the Burning Caves to prove it, and he hasn't come out!

The caves are past the slag heaps, east of town. Oh, bring him home to me, kind sir! I'll give you what I can!

following.speaker: Quell
following.text: Sorry, but I can't go another step unless you know where you're leading me. Can't have the two of us wandering around in here getting cooked, can we?

completion.speaker: Yarra
completion.text: Quell! You great oaf, you're home! Oh, thank you, thank you, kind sir! Please, take this gold. It isn't much, but it's all we have.

journal.text: Find Quell and lead him out of The Burning Caves.

variants.specifics: Torvel: Dorla's grumpy brother Grumbald marched off to the bandit camp in Hollow Wood to complain about their drumming and never came back.

plea.speaker: Dorla
plea.text:
Oh, please, you must help me! My brother Grumbald marched off to the bandit camp in Hollow Wood, west of here. Their drumming kept him up all night, and he swore he'd give them a piece of his mind!

He hasn't come back! Those brutes will skin him alive!

Bring him home to me and I'll give you whatever I can.

reminder.speaker: Dorla
reminder.text: Grumbald! My poor Grumbald! Go and get Grumbald!

following.speaker: Grumbald
following.text: Your slow plodding no longer pleases me. Show me one more bandit and I'll thump him with my bare fists!

completion.speaker: Dorla
completion.text:
Grumbald! You're home! Oh, you stubborn old fool!

Thank you, kind stranger! Please take this Spell Book. It's the finest thing I own.

journal.text: Find a way to free Grumbald from the bandit camp in Hollow Wood.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: Grisel's lazy husband Tobble has let the Ogres lock him in their cage at the old quarry again, to dodge the haying.

plea.speaker: Grisel
plea.text:
Not again! That lazy lump Tobble has let the Ogres catch him again, right when the hay needs bringing in!

He swears they grabbed him, but I know he walks right up to them on purpose. They lock him in a cage at the old quarry east of town, and he sits there eating their stew while I do all the work!

Go and fetch him home, would you? I'll pay you for your trouble.

reminder.speaker: Grisel
reminder.text:
Back already?

Then you're just in time. Grab a pitchfork and help me pitch this hay, since my good-for-nothing husband is still sitting in that Ogre cage!

Go on, then, off with you.

following.speaker: Tobble
following.text: Oh dear, is Grisel waiting up for me?

completion.speaker: Grisel
completion.text:
There he is! Get inside, you lazy lump, the cows need milking!

Thank you, kind stranger. Here's some gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Free Tobble from the Ogre cage and bring him home for The Harvest.
